{{Top|leg}}
The '''mer-9 Protocol Droid''' was a model of [[espionage droid]] created by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] that resembled a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. It stood 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was equipped with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], [[Broadband antenna/Legends|broadband antenna]], [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrain]], and [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]]. It was also fitted with an [[information recording and code-keyed retrieval/broadcast system]] to record and relay intelligence.<ref name="DS">{{WEGCite|story=Den of Spies|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref> [[Mer-9]] was a mer-9 Protocol Droid working for [[Aarica Vost|Bren-Aarica Rordan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|306|mer-9}}</ref>
